description.value: Wolverine Chalet is a recently renovated luxury 9-bedroom private chalet on Tyaughton Lake, part of the Tyax Lodge & Heliskiing property near Gold Bridge in the Southern Chilcotin Range. The chalet accommodates up to 18 guests and is rented as a whole unit, with access to Tyax Lodge amenities including spa, dining, and lake activities when the lodge is open. The remote location at the end of an 8-kilometre lakeside road offers a genuine wilderness setting, though the property is oriented toward group retreats, heliskiing, and mountain biking rather than cycle touring.

address.value: 1 Tyaughton Lake Road, Gold bridge, V0K 1P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wolverine Chalet is a large 9-bedroom private chalet (sleeps 18) at Tyax Lodge, designed for group retreats. Laundry facilities and complimentary Wi-Fi are explicitly listed on the chalet page. The lodge dining room is 70 metres away. Phone matches between OSM (+1-250-238-2221) and the website footer. No mention of bike storage or cycling-specific services; the mud room is described for ski gear only. This is a whole-chalet group rental, which is impractical for individual touring cyclists.
